confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of London price levels for July 2026; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Café, drink and restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by district, booking date and peak-season events. GBP examples were converted at an assumed 1.33 USD per GBP, not a live rate. The FX observation comes from search results that cite the RBA exchange-rates page; the page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The regional basis is Western Europe, using general knowledge of large capitals with strong tourism demand (such as Paris and Amsterdam) as a sanity check. London is placed at the high end for restaurants and for July peak-season accommodation. No live comparison was performed.
